activityType.description: Legacy single-select for backwards compatibility. Prefer 'activityTypes' below. 'all' fetches likes, comments, and posts/reposts in separate passes.
activityType.title: Activity Type (legacy)

activityTypes.description: Multi-select activity types to scrape. Leave empty (or include 'all') to scrape posts, comments, reactions, and shares.
activityTypes.title: Activity Types

cookie.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie. Accepts: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools, or (2) full cookies JSON array from an extension like EditThisCookie.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

language.description: Preferred response language for LinkedIn API requests.
language.title: Language

maxActivitiesPerProfile.description: Maximum number of activity items to scrape per profile (per activity type when 'all' is selected).
maxActivitiesPerProfile.title: Max Activities Per Profile

maxDate.description: Only include activities on or before this ISO date. Leave empty for no upper bound.
maxDate.title: Maximum Date (ISO)

minDate.description: Only include activities on or after this ISO date (e.g. 2024-01-01 or 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z). Leave empty for no lower bound.
minDate.title: Minimum Date (ISO)

profileUrls.description: LinkedIn profile URLs or usernames. Accepts: https://www.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates/, https://uk.linkedin.com/in/williamhgates, or just the username: williamhgates
profileUrls.title: Profile URLs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy configuration. Residential proxy recommended for best results.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
